query_pipeline._synthesis_note: TIMELESS DESIGN: Pipeline is current state (all active incremental ARR), NOT time-scoped. Do NOT say 'This Quarter's Pipeline' or 'Q3 Pipeline'. Say 'Current Pipeline (Incremental ARR)'. TWO FIGURES: Report both timeless total ($22,833,204) AND $5,242,551 closing in FY2027 Q3 (56 deals; q3_scoped_pipeline). COVERAGE: 3.38x, always against the FY2027 Q3 figure, never the timeless total. Format: '$22,833,204 total pipeline (timeless); $X closing this quarter (Y.Yx coverage)'. STAGE BREAKDOWN: Show ALL stages from by_stage dict. Do NOT drop or skip stages. Sum ALL stage counts and verify it equals total_deals (236). If sum < total_deals, explicitly state the gap. TOP DEALS: ALWAYS include close_date for each deal. Flag deals closing > 6 months out (e.g., 'Tubi $500K - closes Jul 2027'). Near-term deals (< 3 months) more actionable. HYGIENE ISSUES: zero_arr_deals uses stage-based rules - Meeting Set excluded (expected $0 at this early stage), renewal stages flagged for $0 renewal_revenue, other stages flagged for $0 incremental ARR. Frame as 'X hygiene issues' not 'X deals with $0 ARR'. They ARE included in total_deals (236) at $0: say so when you give the count (e.g. '236 deals, 22 of them flagged with no ARR entered'). meeting_set_unsized deals are NOT in the count. COMMIT CLOSE DATES: none. PROACTIVE FRAMING: Offer to show upcoming renewals or next quarter's pipeline.
query_pipeline.business_definition_note: Pipeline = sum of expansion_arr + new_arr (dollar-level). Renewal base excluded. Timeless current state - no close_date filtering. Coverage ratio scoped to deals closing in target quarter only.

administrative_stage_share.note: Deals whose deepest recorded stage was 'Review' or 'Disqualified' — both flagged exclude_from_analysis in config/client.yaml, numbered (8, 9) OUT OF SEQUENCE after the real terminal stages (Closed Won=6, Closed Lost=7). ghost_deal_share.note: Lost deals with $0/null deal_value — likely never properly qualified or entered, not a genuine competitive loss. Reported separately; NOT excluded from by_rep/by_segment/stage_of_loss above, which cover the full population.

query_loss_concentration.note: Rep/segment rates are never bare — always reported against the team-average loss rate. Rows below 5 closed deals are flagged insufficient_volume, not reported with a misleading rate. Stage-of-loss uses the canonical bucket mapping, not raw highest_stage_order_reached, to avoid the two administrative stages (order 8, 9) masquerading as sales-cycle depth.

stage_close_rate.note: Pooled across all weeks and complete quarters per stage_order (not per-week). win_rate is null where the classified cohort at that stage is below min_evidence_count.
